name: SkyCity Entertainment Group Limited
note: Casino and entertainment group operating in Auckland, Hamilton, Queenstown and Adelaide (its about page). Its Annual Report 2026 lists SkyCity Auckland Limited as a 100% subsidiary, says its ordinary shares are quoted on the NZX Main Board and the ASX, and lists the substantial product holders as at 30 June 2026: Allan Gray Group 12.55%, Accident Compensation Corporation 11.84%, AustralianSuper Pty Ltd 8.32%.
